title: Medtrum Nano / stop bolus gives error
body:
Last dev. Systematically, if I stop an ongoing bolus, I get a pump unreachable alert.

Either stopping the bolus messes with the BT connection, or triggers a wrong alert message. In both cases, it is a bug.

Logs are below. Check around 18:00

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1729699332528.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17495626/AndroidAPS_LOG_1729699332528.log.zip)

comments.body: Looking into this one, requested more info from Robby at discord

Ok, correction, it was a partial user error. The text says check amounts but the 3 buttons look as it was a pump unreachable alert...

![Screenshot_20241113_115953_Discord.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d359dd21-b4b7-4782-9a2e-9791e18fd4e8)

Clarified the texts in:
https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/pull/3529

In addition we may want to have a separate error dialog for bolus with only an OK button @MilosKozak any thoughts on this?

@MilosKozak  Actually, the message says check IOB (and COB with the last commit) but shows the same 3 buttons as a connection problem. The first one is mute for 5 min, the 2nd says mute...but there are no sounds to mute.

Only an OK button is needed under the "check amount of IOB & COB delivered" message.

Having the 3 buttons (and a _failed_ text) of the connection problems is confusing.

![Screenshot_20241113_115953_Discord.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/22aef865-3e91-4d2a-9929-1de8d902b0f3)
@MilosKozak This bug is still present in dev-d. If I stop an ongoing bolus, I get a _pump unreachable_ alert.

Fixed with #4283 (if the bolus was canceled by the user, it should should return success, it's done that way within Insight Driver).

@jbr7rr, this is my first contribution to Medtrum (could you check my PR please ?).
